title: Integrative discovery of novel antioxidant peptides from bovine hide via peptidomics-guided molecular simulation, quantum chemistry, and experimental validation.
authors: Xin, Xuanying; Park, Sungkwon; Zhang, Wen; Yu, Jia; Hur, Sun Jin; Li, Xiangzi; Choi, Seong-Ho
one_liner_zh: 该文通过肽组学、分子模拟与量子化学筛选牛皮质抗氧化肽，虽涉及蛋白-肽对接（Keap1），但对象为蛋白-小肽而非TF-DNA互作，且无AI/物理模拟方法聚焦于结合机制建模，仅边缘相关。
abstract: Conventional identification methods for antioxidant peptides from bovine hide collagen suffer from poor specificity and high costs. This study employed an integrated approach combining peptidomics, molecular simulation, and quantum chemical calculations to identify ten highly active antioxidant peptides from 6006 candidates. Molecular docking revealed that the peptides bound strongly to the Keap1 protein (binding energies: -7.19 to -12.26 kcal/mol). Quantum chemical calculations demonstrated superior electron-donating capacity, while Fukui function analysis identified key active sites. Cellular assays showed all ten synthetic peptides (1 mg/mL) significantly reduced H(2)O(2)-induced ROS levels in RAW264.7 cells, enhanced SOD/GSH-Px activities, inhibited MDA accumulation, and upregulated the expression of genes in the Nrf2 signaling pathway, which was further confirmed by Western Blot analysis of key proteins in the Keap1-Nrf2 axis. Computational parameters strongly correlated with cellular antioxidant efficacy, with SGPOGPOGP showing optimal protective effects. This tripartite validation strategy provides an innovative paradigm for efficient discovery of bovine hide-derived antioxidant peptides.
abstract_zh: 从牛皮肤胶原蛋白中鉴定抗氧化肽的传统方法存在特异性差和成本高的问题。本研究采用整合肽组学、分子模拟和量子化学计算的综合方法，从6006个候选肽中鉴定出十种高活性抗氧化肽。分子对接显示，这些肽与Keap1蛋白结合紧密（结合能：-7.19至-12.26 kcal/mol）。量子化学计算证明其具有优异的供电子能力，而福井函数分析确定了关键活性位点。细胞实验表明，所有十种合成肽（1 mg/mL）均显著降低H(2)O(2)诱导的RAW264.7细胞中ROS水平，增强SOD/GSH-Px活性，抑制MDA积累，并上调Nrf2信号通路中基因的表达，这一结果通过Western Blot分析Keap1-Nrf2轴关键蛋白得到进一步证实。计算参数与细胞抗氧化功效高度相关，其中SGPOGPOGP显示出最佳保护效果。这种三方验证策略为高效发现牛皮肤来源的抗氧化肽提供了创新范式。
